subject: Problem with shiny and vintage firefox (3.6.17)

messages.author: 61ec521265480c25
messages.subject: Problem with shiny and vintage firefox (3.6.17)
parts:
I have been trying to run a shiny app with a very old version of firefox (3.6.17). The server appears to be running (console says "listening to 8100"), the browser shows the UI, but not the results. Am I correct to suspect that this is due to the age of the browser?

Regards,
Owe

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Problem with shiny and vintage firefox (3.6.17)
parts:
Yes, it's because versions of Firefox that are that old don't support Websockets.

Out of curiosity, does this URL work?
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/rstudio/faithful/
